**What's Changed**
**New**
* EMC Pipes, with a Wrench and pipe upgrades (Basic, Improved, Advanced, Ultimate & Infinity). Pipes move EMC between anything that stores it, use the Wrench on a side to extract from it or sneak to disconnect it. Opening an extracting side sets how it shares EMC out (nearest, furthest, random or round robin) and its redstone mode, depending on its upgrade. Collectors and other sources can push into an extracting side too
* EMC Storage in five tiers (Basic, Improved, Advanced, Ultimate & Infinity). It keeps its EMC when broken or crafted into the next tier, each side can be set to input, output or off with a Wrench, and comparators read how full it is
* Ianthium, an ore (and deepslate ore) that generates in the world and needs a Dark Matter pickaxe, with raw Ianthium, ingots, nuggets and blocks
* The EMC Refinery, which refines Ianthium and other materials with EMC from a Klein Star, an EMC Pipe or anything next to it that gives EMC. Recipes are data driven, show in JEI & EMI, and ProjectE values what they make with the EMC cost included (turn off with the Refining Mapper in ProjectE's mapping config)
* The Arcane Transmutation Table, a block version of the Arcane Transmutation Tablet
* EMC Lock, hold the Toggle EMC Lock key and click an item to stop it being turned into EMC by transmutation, condensers, EMC Links, Transmutation Interfaces and the Arcane Tablet
* Power Flowers have a GUI with three modes: send EMC to the owner (the default), push it into nearby blocks, or keep it for pipes to take
* The EMC display can go anywhere on screen, use /pex emcdisplay to drag it into place or set its position & offsets in the client config
* The Arcane Tablet lets you pick which recipe to use when more than one matches, and fills the grid from transmutation with ghost ingredients that are only paid for once they're used. Recipe transfer from JEI & EMI shows the EMC it needs and anything it can't fill
* EMI support
* Jade & WTHIT get stored EMC from the server, so blocks like condensers update live
* /pex reloademc reloads EMC values without a restart (enableReloadEMCCommand), and reloadEMCAfterCommands reloads them right after ProjectE's /projecte emc commands
* Advancements for the new blocks
* New config options: alchemicalBookDimensionCost, emcDisplayOffsetX & Y, EMC Pipe rates, EMC Storage capacities & rates, enableReloadEMCCommand and reloadEMCAfterCommands

**Changes**
* Alchemical Book teleports to another dimension are measured with each dimension's coordinate scale like a portal (the Nether is 8x), plus a set amount from the new alchemicalBookDimensionCost config (10,000 by default). Arcane books are still free
* Advanced Alchemical Chests are only recolored by shift clicking them with a bag, as their tooltip says. Using a bag no longer recolors a chest up to 20 blocks away, or refuses to open while looking at someone else's chest
* Alchemical Collection leaves drops that carry more than ProjectE keeps, like a filled shulker box or an EMC Storage holding EMC, as normal drops so what they hold isn't lost
* The Arcane Tablet's clear button and crafting leftovers give back items with extra data, like a name, instead of turning them into EMC
* JEI & EMI overlays no longer cover the Arcane Tablet's crafting panel
* Enum config options show translated names in the config screen

**Fixes**
* Fixed an extracting EMC Pipe on an EMC Link creating unlimited EMC
* Fixed a Condenser MK3 locked to an item with no EMC filling its output with free copies
* Fixed Alchemical Collection dropping free items when breaking an EMC Link or Transmutation Interface
* Fixed other players being able to teleport you, spend your EMC and edit your Alchemical Book
* Fixed closing the Arcane Tablet with a recipe in its grid handing out the result as well as the ingredients (#189)
* Fixed opening a Condenser MK3 crashing dedicated servers, and LAN players getting whichever side the host was looking at

**New**

  * Recipe transfer from JEI & EMI shows the EMC it needs and anything it can't fill, and you can pick which recipe to use when more than one matches
  * Rotate, balance, spread and clear buttons for the grid

* Ianthium, an ore (and deepslate ore) that generates in the world and needs a Dark Matter pickaxe, with raw Ianthium, ingots, nuggets and blocks
* The EMC Refinery, which refines Ianthium and other materials with EMC from a Klein Star, an EMC Pipe or anything next to it that gives EMC. Recipes are data driven, show in JEI & EMI, and ProjectE values what they make with the EMC cost included (refiningMapperIncludesEmcCost)
* EMC Lock, hold the Toggle EMC Lock key and click an item to stop it being turned into EMC by transmutation, condensers, EMC Links, Transmutation Interfaces and the Arcane Tablet
* Power Flowers have a GUI with three modes: send EMC to the owner (the default), push it into nearby blocks, or keep it for pipes to take
* The EMC display can go anywhere on screen, use /pex emcdisplay to drag it into place or set its position & offsets in the client config
* Transmutation Tablets can go in a Curios slot, with a key to open them from there
* The Sun Exposure Protection attribute, so any mod can protect against staring at a Compact Sun. Armor in the projectexpansion:sun_exposure_protection item tag gives 25% each
